EST_CANTON_YIELD_V1.name: Canton noodles, cooked in water, 2.5x dry-weight yield (estimate)
EST_CANTON_YIELD_V1.label: Estimated

estimate.assumptions: 100 g FNRI A140 dry wheat canton plus retained cooking water produces 250 g edible cooked noodles. No oil or sauce. Assume 100% nutrient retention. Yield and retention are assumptions, not measured values.
estimate.limitations: Estimate, not a laboratory or manufacturer value. Draining can remove soluble nutrients; actual water uptake varies. Do not use for stir-fried canton or noodles with seasonings.
estimate.range_basis: Not quantified; no evidence-based uncertainty bounds available.
